lessons.note: Per-command help lives in commandHelp (help.go), keyed by the same names as main()'s dispatch switch; help_test.go's dispatchCommands list guards drift (knownCommands from suggest.go/PR #32 is not on this branch yet, so the test is self-contained). main() intercepts -h/--help BEFORE the switch, so commands never see help as a positional.

next: Reviewer (Head of Org Engineering) reviews/merges PR #37. When suggest.go (PR #32) and help.go both land, consider unifying their command lists into a single source of truth.
state_delta: PR #37 (mago/task-34) open: per-command --help focused usage via help.go (commandHelp + wantsHelp) wired into main(); help_test.go added; tests green.
summary: Implemented task #34: added help.go (commandHelp map of focused per-command usage for all 19 dispatched commands + wantsHelp helper) and wired main() to intercept -h/--help for any known command, printing that command's synopsis/flags to stdout and exiting 0 instead of a one-line bad-args error or the global usage dump. Added help_test.go (wantsHelp positives/negatives, every-command-has-help drift guard, no-stray-entries). gofmt/vet/build clean, full go test ./... green, smoke-tested mago task --help and serve -h. Opened PR #37.
